executive_summary: The Tax Abatement Committee meeting held on January 7, 2026, was brief and focused on reviewing and approving the minutes from the previous meeting and the second half billing for tax abatement properties. The meeting was called to order shortly after 3:00 p.m. and concluded within a few minutes. All members confirmed receipt of the necessary documents via email, and there were no objections or amendments to the minutes or billing schedule. The meeting concluded with unanimous approval of both items discussed.
